title: The Sinful Woman Anoints Jesus' Feet
keywords: the parable of the two debtors
description: Jesus is invited to a meal at the Pharisee Simon's house. A woman with a bad reputation comes in, weeps at Jesus' feet, wipes them with her hair, kisses them, and anoints them with expensive oil. Simon is offended, but Jesus tells the parable of the two debtors and says that her many sins are forgiven – therefore her love is great. To the woman he says: "Your faith has saved you; go in peace."
